skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals Direct DMG equal to 20% of the target's Max HP to a single enemy.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Buffs self with +20% True DMG dealt for 2 turns, then applies [ImmuneNotDeathMix2] to all enemies (strips their undying/immunity so they can be killed). Deals Direct DMG equal to 26% of Max HP to all enemies, plus [True DMG] equal to 100% of each enemy's remaining Max HP.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Buffs self with +20% True DMG dealt for 2 turns, then applies [ImmuneNotDeathMix2] to all enemies (strips their undying/immunity so they can be killed). Deals Direct DMG equal to 26% > 34% of Max HP to all enemies, plus [True DMG] equal to 100% of each enemy's remaining Max HP.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains +20% Max HP. On entry, gains 60% [Instant DMG Evasion], becomes immune to [Deterrence], [Stun] and [Specialized Stun], and gains +25% Block Rate.[Instant DMG Evasion]: reduces Direct/Extra/Charge/Berserk DMG to 1.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, gain [No Crit No Death], lasts for 6 rounds. Permanently gain 100% Crit Res Rate. After triggering [Block], reflect 200% Max HP of [True DMG] to the attacker. ———- [No Crit No Death]: For the duration, retains 70% of HP and remain [Undefeated] from fatal Non-Crit hits, and resists fatal Crit hits up to 6 times. (Only sees the first strike for Crit hit)

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: True DMG (max HP) 200% > 300% HP retain 70% > 100% Resist Fatal Crit HIts 6x > 9x

effects.desc: Survive non-fatal attacks (hold about 20% HP without collapsing) and resist a limited number of fatal attacks.
[Faint's] powerful and final stun, which can only be removed with specialized debuffs.
The stun-type control effect prevents the target from taking action during the duration.
Survival buff that, when present, prevents the unit from being crited and cannot die, retaining 70% of its health for the duration of the effect.
Unfavorable effects remove the enemy's invulnerability/immunity so they can be destroyed.
This type of bonus damage is dealt on top of attacks, is reduced by Evasion-type effects, and can be immune after a certain number of turns.
The stun control effect renders the target unable to act and reduces its overall damage immunity by 30%.
